title: Semidiscrete Modeling of Dislocation-Disclination Systems: Finite Element Formulation
summary: We present a numerical formulation for the resolution of finite systems of interacting edge dislocations and wedge disclinations. The approach is based on a finite element discretization of a fourth-order elliptic boundary value problem arising from the mechanical equilibrium equations of plane-strain linear elasticity in the presence of kinematic incompatibilities. The numerical implementation follows a continuous interior penalty discontinuous Galerkin framework and relies on the solution of a finite set of local cell problems.
